mapper.sql: i.id, i.subject, i.content, i.status, i.inquiry_type, i.created_at, i.updated_at, i.user_id, COALESCE(NULLIF(u.nickname, ''), u.username) AS user_display_name, ia.id AS answer_id, ia.content AS answer_content, ia.created_at AS answer_created_at, ia.updated_at AS answer_updated_at
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO inquiries (subject, content, status, user_id, inquiry_type) VALUES (#{subject}, #{content}, #{status}, #{userId}, #{inquiryType})
mapper.select:
SELECT
FROM inquiries i JOIN users u ON u.id = i.user_id LEFT JOIN inquiry_answers ia ON ia.inquiry_id = i.id WHERE i.id = #{id}
SELECT id, subject, content, status, created_at, updated_at, user_id, inquiry_type FROM inquiries WHERE id = #{id} FOR UPDATE
